question: The earth crust has only ______ carbon in the form of minerals.
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.02%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The earth crust has only **0.02% carbon** in the form of minerals.
 
• Carbon is one of the most abundant elements on earth, but most of it exists in the form of **carbon dioxide gas** in the atmosphere and dissolved in the oceans.
 
• T
